module: "nearPole" stunt zone type: a striped pole (delineator, config vehicles/delineator/stripes.pc) is spawned at pos; the player scores points by drifting close to it without touching it. The module returns a constructor called by gameplay_drift_stuntZones.setStuntZones; it is not an extension. Emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished with the sub-hook onNearPoleAccomplished (angle, closeness and nearPole base points).
notes: A corner of the vehicle must come within maxDist = 4 m of the pole; the score is awarded when the vehicle moves away (center-to-pole distance greater than in the previous frame) and the pole has not been hit.

closeness = 1 - (minCornerDist / 4), where minCornerDist is the minimum distance from a vehicle corner to the pole; the closer, the higher the score (score = angle * closeness / 90 * points, in scoring).
Hitting the pole (collision read from objectCollisions) sets hitPole to true and removes the marker: the zone can then no longer be validated.
Like hitPole, reset() puts the pole back in place and recreates the marker after 0.1 s.

C.desc: nearPole zone. Fields: data = {id, zoneData = {pos}}, marker, activeData = {veh, hitPole, lastFrameHitPole, available, resetFlag, lastFramePlDist, minCornerDist}.

clear.desc: Removes the pole vehicle and its marker.

clearMarker.desc: Removes the race marker if it exists.

createMarker.desc: Creates an "overhead" race marker (radius 5) 2.5 m above the pole.

resetData.desc: Resets activeData (available = true, distances to infinity).

reset.desc: Puts the pole back in place (physics and mesh reset), reinitializes the data, then recreates the marker after 0.1 s via a job.

init.desc: Internal constructor: stores the data, spawns the striped pole at zoneData.pos, creates the marker.

accomplish.desc: Success: removes the marker, makes the zone unavailable and emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished (sub-hook onNearPoleAccomplished with currDegAngle, closeness, points).

detectStunt.desc: Iterates over the vehicle's 4 corners (getVehCorners), stores the minimum distance and marks the zone as accomplished when the vehicle moves away from the pole without having hit it.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: updates the marker and detects a collision between the drift vehicle and the pole.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: If the destroyed vehicle is the pole, forgets the pole and removes the zone from the manager.

isAvailable.desc: Returns whether the pole can still earn points.

returns.desc: true as long as the zone has not been accomplished.
